description: [FREE: 25 calls/day, then $0.01 USDC per call via x402] Before your agent quotes, cites or summarises a document, check each quote against the source text. Per quote: "exact" (verbatim, with location), "same_words" (only capitalisation, spacing or punctuation differ), "numbers_differ" (the passage exists but a number was changed, e.g. 12% vs 21%), "close_but_different" (a similar passage exists, with the words that differ), or "not_found" (the source does not say it). Also flags a negation that was added or dropped ("not"). Returns the line, character offsets and the source passage. Up to 50 quotes per call against up to 600000 characters of source. Deterministic string matching, no model.
